addition.item: ⁠“Joomanji updates” box on the Iris home page: all your pending Joomanji updates, and an “Update all” button that goes through Joomla.
⁠Media library: right-click menu (or the Menu key, Shift+F10), F2 to rename, Delete to delete.
⁠Galleries: “New folder”, the file name under each card, 3:4 and 2:3 formats, “Save as copy”.
⁠“A folder” gallery: the “-” of a row asks whether to hide the image or delete the file from the folder.

fix.item: ⁠Delete and move now work with hosts that refused these requests (error 403).
⁠Large galleries save with no server limit, and their previews load on demand.
⁠Documents: PDF thumbnails in WebP, Word label in blue, buttons under the text in Tiles.

note.item: ⁠Requires Joomla 6.2 or newer. Nothing to set again.

fix.item: ⁠With the JCE editor, the Iris button stopped JCE from starting: the writing area stayed empty, without its buttons. JCE shows up normally again.
⁠Iris took JCE for TinyMCE, the Joomla editor. Under JCE the “Iris - Galleries” button works; gallery cards stay a TinyMCE feature.
⁠The confirmation window stays fixed on screen and no longer scrolls the article back up.

note.item: ⁠Requires Joomla 6.2 or newer. A site still on Joomla 6.1 keeps its current version and is offered nothing that could break it.

fix.item: ⁠“Update in the article” was shown with one slash too many.
⁠A gallery card title is no longer underlined on hover (there were two lines).

addition.item: ⁠Galleries inside the article: the “Iris - Galleries” button opens a panel with three tabs, Layout, Galleries and Reuse.
⁠The 15 layouts of the Iris Galleries module can be placed straight into the article.
⁠Each placed gallery becomes a card in the editor: move it, edit it, preview it or remove it.

note.item: ⁠Ready for Joomla 6.2. Nothing to set again.
